rules.description: Applicant must be at least 16 years old (or turning 16 in the next 3 weeks) for an adult passport
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be at least 16 years old to apply for an adult passport name change. Use the child passport service instead.

rules.description: Applicant must have an existing UK passport to change the name on
rules.reason_if_failed: You need an existing UK passport to change your name. Apply for a first adult passport instead.

rules.description: Applicant must provide valid evidence of name change (marriage certificate or deed poll)
rules.reason_if_failed: You must provide a marriage certificate, civil partnership certificate, or deed poll as evidence of your name change

rules.description: Current passport must not be reported as lost or stolen without being cancelled first
rules.reason_if_failed: Your passport is reported as lost or stolen but not cancelled. You must cancel it before applying for a replacement.

edge_cases.description: Passport has been lost or stolen
edge_cases.action: Must cancel existing passport before proceeding. Route to cancellation process first.

edge_cases.description: Current passport is damaged (pages ripped, cover coming away, stains, illegible details)
edge_cases.action: Damaged passport must be replaced rather than renewed. Assess damage severity and proceed with replacement application.
Previous passport with visa will be returned separately. Advise citizen to carry both passports when travelling. Russia has different rules - trigger handoff.

edge_cases.description: Application requires video interview for identity verification
edge_cases.action: Book video interview after initial assessment. Interview must be completed before final decision.
Route to child passport service. Different application process and requirements.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is currently outside the UK
edge_cases.action: Different process for overseas applications. Route to overseas passport service.
